SELECT ifnull(sum(sic.survey_task_money),0) FROM survey_risk_case_info a left join survey_investigator_case sic on sic.survey_info_id = a.id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.survey_state = 28 AND (a.price_1_is_calc = 0 or a.price_2_is_calc = 0) AND sic.survey_org_id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select count(1) from ( select a.survey_info_id from ( select (case f.parent_id when 0 then f.id else f.parent_id end ) org_id,o.survey_info_id from survey_assign_org o left join survey_risk_case_info r on o.survey_info_id = r.id left join survey_consignor n on r.entrust_org_id = n.id left join survey_franchisee f on o.survey_org_id = f.id where 1 = 1
and n.org_attr = #{orgAttr,jdbcType=INTEGER}
AND date_format(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(r.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(r.entrust_report_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(r.entrust_report_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
and o.report_date > o.utter_end_time
and o.report_date > o.org_end_time and o.extension_time is not null
and r.entrust_org_id = #{entrustOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
and r.entrust_org_id in (${entrustOrgIds})
) a group by a.org_id,a.survey_info_id having a.org_id = #{surveyOrgId,jdbcType=BIGINT} )t

select IFNULL(SUM(aa.inscompany_money),0) entrustAgreementMoney from ( SELECT c.inscompany_money FROM survey_consignor a LEFT JOIN survey_risk_case_info b ON a.id=b.entrust_org_id LEFT JOIN survey_assign_org c ON b.id=c.survey_info_id LEFT JOIN survey_franchisee f ON c.survey_org_id = f.id WHERE a.org_attr = 1 AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND f.delete_flag = 0 AND (f.id=#{surveyOrgId} OR f.parent_id = #{surveyOrgId} )
and b.entrust_org_id in (${entrustOrgIds})
AND b.entrust_report_start_date IS NOT NULL
AND date_format(b.entrust_report_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(b.entrust_report_start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND b.entrust_report_end_date IS NOT NULL
AND date_format(b.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') >= date_format(#{startTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND date_format(b.entrust_report_end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') <= date_format(#{endTime,jdbcType=DATE},'%Y-%m-%d')
) aa
